defects.claim: A synchronous throw from a custom image loader leaves the cache entry pending forever, so imagePending stays true, imageLoadsSettled has nothing to await, and retryImage skips it
defects.scenario: An installed loader throws synchronously after the cache has set its loading state, so neither promise handler runs and the entry stays pending forever
defects.cause: loading state is set before the loader call, and a synchronous throw is never caught

defects.claim: A sizing load that throws synchronously leaves the vector reraster pending flag stuck
defects.scenario: An installed loader throws synchronously after the cache has set its loading state, so neither promise handler runs and the entry stays pending forever
defects.cause: loading state is set before the loader call, and a synchronous throw is never caught

defects.claim: A failed picking frame strands borrowed effect targets because the ID frame path never reclaims the pool, so repeated failures keep allocating new targets
defects.scenario: A child or effect throws during renderIds while a borrowed offscreen target is held; later picking frames before the next color frame allocate more targets instead of getting the stranded ones back
defects.cause: pool reclaim runs only in render(), not on the ID frame path
